Zone B · stack position

The Eight Faces of Ti

The canvas draws Ti as a lattice: a network of claims, each tested against the others. Where Ti sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how that network runs. Click a position to see the change, from the first seat's effortless precision to the eighth's corrosive static, and drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.

Zone C · feeder coupling

What Feeds Into Ti?

Ti judges; it does not gather. A perceiving function — its feeder — has to deliver the raw material it tests, and which one does the delivering changes what gets built. Click a feeder to watch the lattice change shape.

Zone D · verification lab

The Verification Lab

Watch Ti handle input in real time. Each button sends the lab a different kind of event — an unrelated fact, a connection, a contradiction — and the meters track what each one costs.
